description: Construct a planar grid by drawing a square of side 1, and then at each corner, place the midpoint of a square of side 1/sqrt(2), rotated from the first by 45 degs. From each of these four squares continue placing new squares in the same way, each time rescaled by a factor of 1/sqrt(2), as long as they don't overlap any earlier squares. Sequence gives number of squares added at the n-th stage.
